name: shop
description: Shop across millions of stores: find and compare over a billion products, build carts, check out with Shop Pay, and track orders and deliveries.

interface.longDescription: Shop across millions of stores: find and compare over a billion products, build carts, and check out. Sign in with Shop to pay with Shop Pay, use your saved addresses, get results personalized to you, and track your orders and deliveries. At stores that don't support Shop Pay directly, approve the purchase and your agent completes it with a single-use card.
capabilities: Search over 1 billion products from millions of stores
Pay with Shop Pay and saved addresses
Approve single-use card purchases at stores without Shop Pay
defaultPrompt: Find a waterproof running jacket under $150 that ships to Canada
